billing_bound_interpretation: These are conditional public-PAYG operational maximum-liability reservations, not prompt-token estimates, eventual-spend predictions, invoices or protection against provider misbilling.

The full-window input bound is an inference from each documented single-request context and its usage categories. Payload limits are separate local safety guards, not certified byte-to-provider-token conversions.

Anthropic ordinary input, cache reads and cache writes all count toward context. Reasoning is billed within output and bounded by max_tokens. OpenAI prompt/cache accounting uses unadjusted token counts; reported cache-write tokens are not added a second time.

Usage/model/tier/geography categories outside the frozen accounting policy require a hold, not a cheaper assumption. Unknown delivery retains the full reservation. No fee-bearing provider server tool is requested by these profiles.
Editor turns each repeat and bill their own inputs/output; a request reservation is not an entire conversation budget. Global phase/cell/token/HTTP ceilings still apply.

fresh_public_pricing_markdown.hash_basis: Exact unauthenticated HTTP response bytes; no text transformation. Public docs only, explicit empty proxy handler, no account/token-count/credential/inference endpoint.

editor_selector_quality.basis: Full context at the most expensive allowed cache category (one-hour write), plus all output/thinking, with a conservative 1.1 geographic allowance. The allowance is retained for the shared role policy even where global routing is explicit; it is not a claim of an actual global surcharge. Priority Tier excludes the exact Opus 5 model; Fast mode is not requested.

group.basis: Reserve the whole 1.05M context independently of maximum output, conservatively overstating a shared input/output window. Apply the documented >272K long-input rates, maximum supported inherited public tier, default cache-write price, and geographic allowance. A longer 12h write is a Responses-only opt-in, not part of this native Chat request.

strategy.basis: Full documented context reserved at the five-minute write rate, plus every allowed output/thinking token. Global standard controls are explicit. One-hour writes require an explicit extended TTL; the strategy body does not request one.
